description: This file defines a report class Gstr2Report for generating GST return 2 reports in an ERP system, including methods for data retrieval, column setup, and filtering based on business type.

classes.name: Gstr2Report
classes.description: A report class inheriting from Gstr1Report to generate GST return 2 data with specific filtering and column setup.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Function to instantiate Gstr2Report with optional filters and run the report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing filters, columns, data, and GST-related attributes.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves invoice data, processes tax details, and prepares report rows based on GST categories and business type.

methods.name: get_igst_invoices
methods.description: Identifies IGST invoices from tax details and stores their identifiers.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on filters for querying invoices.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns dynamically based on business type and GST data.
